mcq_fix.s: The New Public Sector Enterprise Policy for Atmanirbhar Bharat (2021) favours:

mcq_drop.why: 'Reforms 2.0' is a single column's framing, not an exam fact

pyq_bad.why: garbled stem/options; also wrong topic: UN poverty decade
wrong topic: Planning Commission Deputy Chairmen

patterns: Only one on-topic PYQ: NEP 1991 announced under PM P.V. Narasimha Rao (FM Manmohan Singh) - a direct person item.
Expect direct year/person facts: FERA to FEMA 1999, current account convertibility 1994, Navratnas 1997, MRTP 1969 -> Competition Act 2002.
Traps: capital account convertibility never fully adopted; devaluation is stabilisation, delicensing is structural adjustment.
App MCQs are mostly multi-statement items on reform content; factually sound.
